_note: Family curation. `merges` folds vault instance_of targets that have no note into an existing family. `families.<slug>` may override name, oneLine, body (plain site prose, never Jung's words), spectrum.position, palette.

anima-figure.name: Anima figure
anima-figure.oneLine: The woman behind a man's moods and projections: muse, siren, unknown guide.

anima-mundi.name: Anima mundi
anima-mundi.oneLine: The world-soul pictured as a guiding woman between God and nature.

anthropos.name: Anthropos
anthropos.oneLine: The primordial cosmic man in whom the divine world-principle appears.

antichrist.name: Antichrist
antichrist.oneLine: The adversary who follows Christ as a shadow follows the body.

ape.name: Ape
ape.oneLine: The divine, archaic and diabolical ape: instinct that mimics the spirit.

arrow.name: Arrow
arrow.oneLine: The wound shot from outside that proves to come from within.

ascent-descent.name: Ascent and descent
ascent-descent.oneLine: The work as a cycle: spirit rises to fetch the seed, then falls to fertilize the earth.

ass.name: Ass
ass.oneLine: The ass as bearer of mana: humble beast, sacred burden.

atman-brahman.name: Atman and Brahman
atman-brahman.oneLine: The Upanishadic self as light and cosmic ground; the golden germ.

bird.name: Bird
bird.oneLine: Winged carriers of spirit and thought, messengers between worlds.

cave.name: Cave
cave.oneLine: The dark enclosure of birth, initiation and rebirth, where the hidden is kept.

chakra.name: Chakra
chakra.oneLine: The yogic body-map of wheel and lotus centres, climbing from root to crown.

chalice.name: Chalice
chalice.oneLine: The vessel that heals, sanctifies and divines; the hollowed horn.

christ-figure.name: Christ figure
christ-figure.oneLine: Christ as ideal, mediator and shepherd: the figure of wholeness in the Christian world.

churinga.name: Churinga
churinga.oneLine: Decorated sacred stones of Central Australian tribes, bearers of ancestral soul.

circle.name: Circle
circle.oneLine: The closed round form: wholeness without beginning or end.

circulation-of-light.name: Circulation of light
circulation-of-light.oneLine: Rotation about a centre as the movement of the psyche and of light.

coniunctio.name: Coniunctio
coniunctio.oneLine: The union of opposites: king and queen, sun and moon, conscious and unconscious.

corn-god.name: Corn god
corn-god.oneLine: The god who is food: the grain buried, sprouting and eaten.

cross.name: Cross
cross.oneLine: Four directions met at a centre: instrument of suffering and sign of the quaternity.

crown.name: Crown
crown.oneLine: The circle of rule and radiance set on the head of the transformed.

demiurge.name: Demiurge
demiurge.oneLine: The ignorant or flawed maker-god of the Gnostic cosmos.

devil.name: Devil
devil.oneLine: The adversary as intellect: Mephisto, the shadow side of the sacred.

dismemberment.name: Dismemberment
dismemberment.oneLine: The god torn apart and scattered so that he can be gathered anew.

divine-child.name: Divine child
divine-child.oneLine: The newborn god, threatened at birth and strangely invincible.

divine-pair.name: Divine pair
divine-pair.oneLine: God and goddess as one paired form: majestic father and majestic mother.

dog.name: Dog
dog.oneLine: Loyal companion and guardian of the threshold, hound of the underworld.

double.name: Double
double.oneLine: The paired mortal and immortal twin: the Dioscuri, the second bird in the tree.

dove.name: Dove
dove.oneLine: The white bird of the whitening: the pneuma that descends and purifies.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.oneLine: The chaos-monster set against the highest god, and the hero's first adversary.

dual-mother.name: Dual mother
dual-mother.oneLine: Being born of two mothers, one human and one divine.

eagle.name: Eagle
eagle.oneLine: The bird of spirit and sun, the high counterpart of the serpent.

eye.name: Eye
eye.oneLine: The eye as seeing and as womb: the little image in the pupil.

filius-philosophorum.name: Filius philosophorum
filius-philosophorum.oneLine: The alchemists' son: a hermaphroditic child born of the prima materia.

fire.name: Fire
fire.oneLine: The transforming flame of the work, at once purifying and consuming.

fish.name: Fish
fish.oneLine: Redeemer, soul and food: Oannes, Ichthys, the double fish of the zodiac.

furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.oneLine: The athanor, the fiery kiln where the matter is tried and changed.

garden.name: Garden
garden.oneLine: The walled green space of the work: paradise recovered, where the sun rises.

giant.name: Giant
giant.oneLine: The oversized primordial being: ogre, titan, threat to the child-hero.

god-image.name: God image
god-image.oneLine: The inherited set of images in which the divine is pictured.

golden-flower.name: Golden flower
golden-flower.oneLine: The solar essence blooming as a flower: Chinese golden flower, Western rose.

grail.name: Grail
grail.oneLine: The shining vessel and castle at the end of the quest.

head.name: Head
head.oneLine: The head as seat of mind and omega element: the sons of the Golden Head.

heart.name: Heart
heart.oneLine: The bodily centre and the deep heart of the mystics.

helen-of-troy.name: Helen of Troy
helen-of-troy.oneLine: The ever-returning beauty: cause of war, companion of Simon Magus, Faust's Helen.

hermaphrodite.name: Hermaphrodite
hermaphrodite.oneLine: Primal bisexual wholeness: Plato's original man, the alchemical double being.

holy-ghost.name: Holy Ghost
holy-ghost.oneLine: The third person of the Trinity, descending into matter in alchemical thought.

homunculus.name: Homunculus
homunculus.oneLine: The little man of the alchemists, formed in the vessel.

horn.name: Horn
horn.oneLine: The single pointed outgrowth that heals: unicorn, rhinoceros, antelope.

horse.name: Horse
horse.oneLine: The spirit-animal that talks and knows: the unconscious as swift, miraculous beast.

i-ching-hexagram.name: I Ching hexagram
i-ching-hexagram.oneLine: The line-figures of the I Ching, from the river-map of the dragon's magic signs.

island.name: Island
island.oneLine: The enclosed land in the sea: castle-rock and paradise as refuge.

khidr.name: Khidr
khidr.oneLine: The ever-living guide of Islamic tradition who teaches at the meeting of the seas.

king-queen-pair.name: King and queen
king-queen-pair.oneLine: The royal pair of the work: sun and moon, brother and sister in the bath.

lamb.name: Lamb
lamb.oneLine: The sacrificial white animal and its Christian sublimation, the Lamb of God.

lamia.name: Lamia
lamia.oneLine: The woman-monster who takes children and lovers.

lapis.name: Lapis
lapis.oneLine: The stone that is no stone: end of the work, body, spirit and medicine at once.

lingam-yoni.name: Lingam and yoni
lingam-yoni.oneLine: Union as image: the standing stone in its base, Shiva and Shakti.

lion.name: Lion
lion.oneLine: The royal, devouring beast of the alchemists: Mercurius in his volatile form.

lion-headed-god.name: Lion-headed god
lion-headed-god.oneLine: The leontocephalic figure of unending time: Mithraic Aion, the lion-faced demiurge.

lotus.name: Lotus
lotus.oneLine: The seated flower in which gods are born and enthroned.

lumen-naturae.name: Lumen naturae
lumen-naturae.oneLine: The innate light of nature, a second source of knowledge beside revelation.

magical-companion.name: Magical companion
magical-companion.oneLine: The unrecognized fellow-traveller who joins the quester on the road.

magician.name: Magician
magician.oneLine: The old master of dream and fairytale, in white and in black.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.oneLine: The attractive stone: an invisible pull toward the centre.

maiden.name: Maiden
maiden.oneLine: The young woman of dream and myth: helper, bride, bait, soul in bloom.

mandala.name: Mandala
mandala.oneLine: Circles and centred quaternary figures that arise spontaneously: pictures of wholeness.

melusina.name: Melusina
melusina.oneLine: The half-woman, half-serpent water-spirit of Lusignan.

mercurius.name: Mercurius
mercurius.oneLine: The double-natured spirit of quicksilver: thief's god, guide and trickster.

merkabah.name: Merkabah
merkabah.oneLine: Ezekiel's throne-chariot: four living creatures, four wheels, the glory enthroned.

monster.name: Monster
monster.oneLine: The many-membered composite beast of the prima materia.

moon.name: Moon
moon.oneLine: The night light that holds the dead and the seed.

moth.name: Moth
moth.oneLine: The soul-creature drawn fatally to the flame.

mother-goddess.name: Mother goddess
mother-goddess.oneLine: Goddess, Mother of God, Virgin, Sophia: the many figures of the mother.

mothers-of-faust.name: Mothers of Faust
mothers-of-faust.oneLine: The formless, generative realm of the Mothers, reached by a key in Faust II.

mountain.name: Mountain
mountain.oneLine: The high place of ascent and vision, the axis of the world.

night-sea-journey.name: Night sea journey
night-sea-journey.oneLine: The hero's descent into the monster's belly and the deep, to rise renewed.

nigredo.name: Nigredo
nigredo.oneLine: The blackening: first stage of the work, putrefaction and melancholy.

nixie.name: Nixie
nixie.oneLine: The half-fish water-maiden of the fisherman's net: siren, nymph, lamia.

paradise.name: Paradise
paradise.oneLine: The enclosed garden of origin and end, with the tree of life.

peacock.name: Peacock
peacock.oneLine: The spread tail of all colours, seen just before the whitening.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.oneLine: The treasure at the bottom of the water, guarded by the dragon.

phallus.name: Phallus
phallus.oneLine: The ithyphallic old man and the generative power: Hermes Kyllenios.

philosophers-egg.name: Philosophers' egg
philosophers-egg.oneLine: The sealed vessel as egg: the germ of the stone.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.oneLine: The fire-bird that renews itself from its own ashes.

planetary-gods.name: Planetary gods
planetary-gods.oneLine: The seven planetary deities of ascent-rites, of Hades and of the metals.

plough.name: Plough
plough.oneLine: The tool that makes the earth fruitful, echoing the marriage act.

point.name: Point
point.oneLine: The dimensionless centre from which the circle is drawn.

prima-materia.name: Prima materia
prima-materia.oneLine: The initial stuff of the work: dragon, tail-eater, dark chaos.

quaternity.name: Quaternity
quaternity.oneLine: Four-ness of the whole: four functions round a centre, four gates, four evangelists.

raven.name: Raven
raven.oneLine: The black bird of the blackening, messenger of the dark stage of the work.

rebis.name: Rebis
rebis.oneLine: The two-bodied child of the coniunctio, half male and half female.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.oneLine: The dead awakened: the king reborn from the dungeon.

rose.name: Rose
rose.oneLine: The rose as mandala-centre and the philosophers' rose garden.

rotundum.name: Rotundum
rotundum.oneLine: The round thing of alchemy, the perfect sphere of the work.

rubedo.name: Rubedo
rubedo.oneLine: The reddening: last stage of the work, the dawn after the whitening.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.oneLine: The act of transformation in which priest and victim are one.

salamander.name: Salamander
salamander.oneLine: The fire-dwelling lizard that lives in the flame and is not consumed.

salt.name: Salt
salt.oneLine: Salt as arcane substance: a cosmic, lunar and feminine principle in alchemy.

scarab.name: Scarab
scarab.oneLine: The dung-beetle as emblem of self-generation, pushing its ball from the earth.

senex-figure.name: Senex
senex-figure.oneLine: The old man of dream and myth: guide, teacher, bearer of meaning.

serpent.name: Serpent
serpent.oneLine: Circle-maker, earth-power, mercurial spirit: the snake in its many valences.

shiva.name: Shiva
shiva.oneLine: The Indian god with his Shakti: the Tantric pair in continuous union.

sol-niger.name: Sol niger
sol-niger.oneLine: The blackened sun: the centre darkened at the start of the work.

solificatio.name: Solificatio
solificatio.oneLine: Becoming sun: the crowned initiate, the face that shines like the sun.

sophia.name: Sophia
sophia.oneLine: Divine Wisdom personified as feminine, bride and teacher of the art.

soul-bird.name: Soul bird
soul-bird.oneLine: The soul as a small bird, led out of the grave by the guide of souls.

spark.name: Spark
spark.oneLine: The scintilla: a small light hidden in the dark of matter.

stag.name: Stag
stag.oneLine: The fleeing, uncatchable deer of the alchemists, paired with the unicorn.

star.name: Star
star.oneLine: Rays from a centre: pentagram, many-rayed star, star-cross.

stone.name: Stone
stone.oneLine: The stone that kills and quickens, found on the dunghill and crowned as king.

sulphur.name: Sulphur
sulphur.oneLine: Sulphur, the fiery active principle of the metals in alchemy.

sun.name: Sun
sun.oneLine: Source of life and wholeness: Helios, the shining face, the red ball, the gold.

sun-hero.name: Sun hero
sun-hero.oneLine: The solar hero who is swallowed and born again with each day.

swan.name: Swan
swan.oneLine: The white water-bird of the soul, between earth and sky.

swastika.name: Swastika
swastika.oneLine: The gamma-cross in right- and left-hand rotation, alone and inside mandalas.

tao.name: Tao
tao.oneLine: The Way: the central light between the eyes, the unity of life and consciousness.

tauroctony.name: Tauroctony
tauroctony.oneLine: The Mithraic scene of the god kneeling on the bull, sword at its shoulder.

temenos.name: Temenos
temenos.oneLine: The delimited sacred space: snake-circle, city wall, church precinct, cloister garden.

tetramorph.name: Tetramorph
tetramorph.oneLine: The four creatures of man, lion, ox and eagle about the throne.

toad.name: Toad
toad.oneLine: The chthonic, devouring creature of damp and dark.

treasure.name: Treasure
treasure.oneLine: The precious thing guarded in the dark by snake or dragon.

tree.name: Tree
tree.oneLine: The cosmic and philosophical tree: axis, shelter and body of the work.

trickster-figure.name: Trickster figure
trickster-figure.oneLine: The shape-shifting fool of myth: culture-bringer, blunderer and scapegoat.

trinity.name: Trinity
trinity.oneLine: Three in one: the stone trinus et unus, king, son and spirit.

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.oneLine: The wild, chaste horned beast, where Christ and Mercurius meet in one image.

uroboros.name: Uroboros
uroboros.oneLine: The serpent or dragon devouring its own tail, closing the circle.

venus.name: Venus
venus.oneLine: Queen Venus: heavenly beauty set against terrible Proserpina.

vessel.name: Vessel
vessel.oneLine: The sealed glass vessel of the work: retort, pelican, womb.

virgin.name: Virgin
virgin.oneLine: The feminine carrier of the work in its virginal aspect: Mary, virgo terrae.

water.name: Water
water.oneLine: Descent-water: the dark lake, the deep well, the underworldly stream.

well-spring.name: Well and spring
well-spring.oneLine: The life-water and its source: fountain, spring, aqua nostra.

wind.name: Wind
wind.oneLine: The fertilizing breath: the West Wind, father of the winds, spirit that conceives.

world-clock.name: World clock
world-clock.oneLine: A clock-like mandala with a dark centre and turning rings.

world-wheel.name: World wheel
world-wheel.oneLine: The wheel of existence with the cock, snake and pig at its hub.

worm.name: Worm
worm.oneLine: The lowest, first form of renewal, from which the phoenix rises.

yantra.name: Yantra
yantra.oneLine: Geometric instrument of ritual: triangles, lotuses and circles round a point.

hero.name: Hero
hero.oneLine: The overcoming young hero: Jung’s Siegfried dream, and every young champion after.

death.name: Death
death.oneLine: The dying that turns into its opposite — the enantiodromia wheel.

greening-tree.name: Greening tree
greening-tree.oneLine: The greening man growing from the temple’s ruins — nature overtaking the ideal.
